rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doubting whether something is true or intended.

example.english: I doubt whether he is really ill.
example.traditional: 我懷疑佢係咪真係病咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 waai4 ji4 keoi5 hai6 mai6 zan1 hai6 beng6 zo2

rows.note: Use this for the stronger meaning, where you do not believe a claim or person.

example.english: I doubt he was telling the truth when he said he wasn't late.
example.traditional: 我唔信佢話自己冇遲到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 seon3 keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 ci4 dou3

rows.note: Use this when you are unable or unwilling to be certain, rather than actively disbelieving something.

example.english: I still doubt whether it will rain tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我而家仲唔敢肯定聽日會唔會落雨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zung6 m4 gam2 hang2 ding6 ting1 jat6 wui5 m4 wui5 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for disbelief or suspicion about whether something is true.

example.english: I have some doubt about what he said.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 jau5 waai4 ji4

rows.note: Use this when the doubt is an unresolved question or uncertainty about an issue.

example.english: I still have a doubt about this matter.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 zung6 jau5 ji4 man6

rows.note: Use this when the doubt is a suspicion, especially suspicion about another person's motives or honesty.

example.english: You don't need to doubt me; I didn't cheat you.
example.traditional: 你唔使咁有疑心，我冇呃你。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 jau5 ji4 sam1 ngo5 mou5 aak1 nei5
